volatility.note: sigma = bps per root second from Binance quote mids (15 s overlapping returns, ADR 0004). Auto-recordings start when the last 5 minutes are volatile, so their lead-in and trigger sigma are the selection; the ratio shows how far the recording stays above its own lead-in.
